summary.text: You can receive up to $3,440 a month from age 65, or up to $4,580 from age 70.

details.heading: What affects your payout
details.body: Your monthly payout depends on your Retirement Account savings and your age when you start receiving payouts.

details.heading: Examples at age 65
details.body: Under the CPF LIFE Standard Plan, $50,000 in your RA at age 55 corresponds to $490 a month from age 65. $150,000 corresponds to $1,250 a month.

details.heading: Examples at age 70
details.body: Under the CPF LIFE Standard Plan, $50,000 in your RA at age 55 corresponds to $670 a month from age 70. $150,000 corresponds to $1,670 a month.

example_phrasings: How much CPF payouts can I get every month?
How much will my CPF pay each month?
What monthly CPF payout can I expect?

sources.page_title: How much CPF payouts can I get every month?

quotes.text: Under CPF LIFE, you can receive up to $3,440 per month for life starting from age 65. For each year that you defer, your payouts will increase by up to 7%. This means that you can receive up to $4,580 if you choose to start your payout at age 70.
Your monthly payout amount depends on the amount of savings in your Retirement Account (RA) and your age at the point you start your payouts.
